# LinkedIn Education Scraper

> Send a profile URL you already have. You get each school, the degree, the field of study, the years, and the school URL.

Mawsool publishes this as an Apify Actor. Starting from $0.45 per 1,000 profiles.

## Run

- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-education
- Call: `oday/mawsool-linkedin-profile-education`
- API key: https://mawsool.tech/ and https://docs.mawsool.tech/
- Contact: osama@mawsool.tech, info@mawsool.tech

## Use it when

You are matching alumni, a school, or a degree.

## Use something else when

You need the full profile. Use the LinkedIn Profile Scraper.

## Page

- LinkedIn education history from a profile URL: docs/linkedin-education-history.md

Mawsool is not affiliated with LinkedIn.
